def process(water2020, water2021, water2022, water2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    def prep(df):
        out = df.copy()
        out = out[out['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'fresh']
        v = out['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        out['violationFlag'] = v.isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', '1'])
        out['sampleDate'] = pd.to_datetime(out['Sample Date'], errors='coerce')
        out['year'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        out['month'] = out['sampleDate'].dt.month.astype('Int64')
        out = out.dropna(subset=['year', 'month'])
        return out

    allw = pd.concat([prep(water2020), prep(water2021), prep(water2022), prep(water2023)], ignore_index=True)

    g = allw.groupby(['year', 'month'], as_index=False).agg(
        totalSamples=('violationFlag', 'size'),
        exceedSamples=('violationFlag', 'sum')
    )
    g['exceedanceRate'] = g['exceedSamples'] / g['totalSamples']

    # full month grid 2020-2023
    years = list(range(2020, 2024))
    months = list(range(1, 13))
    grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([years, months], names=['year', 'month']).to_frame(index=False)
    g = grid.merge(g[['year', 'month', 'exceedanceRate']], on=['year', 'month'], how='left')

    # impute missing with median of that month across non-missing years in 2020-2023
    monthMedian = g.groupby('month', as_index=False)['exceedanceRate'].median(numeric_only=True).rename(columns={'exceedanceRate': 'monthMedian'})
    g = g.merge(monthMedian, on='month', how='left')
    g['exceedanceRateImputed'] = g['exceedanceRate'].fillna(g['monthMedian'])

    return g[['year', 'month', 'exceedanceRateImputed']].sort_values(['year', 'month']).reset_index(drop=True)
input.summary: Compute monthly exceedance rate for Fresh beaches from water-body-testing-{2020,2021,2022,2023}.csv: filter Beach Type Description=='Fresh'; parse Sample Date to get month; normalize Violation to boolean (yes/y/true/1); group by [year, month] to compute exceedanceRate=exceed/total; create complete grid for years 2020-2023 and months 1-12; impute missing exceedanceRate with the median exceedanceRate of the same month across non-missing years within 2020-2023; output [year, month, exceedanceRateImputed] sorted.

def process(precipAmherst, precipAshburnham, precipBoston, precipChatham) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    month_cols = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']
    month_num = {m:i+1 for i,m in enumerate(month_cols)}

    def to_long(df, station):
        d = df.copy()
        d['Year'] = d['Year'].astype(str).str.strip()
        d = d[d['Year'].str.fullmatch(r'\d{4}')].copy()
        d['year'] = pd.to_numeric(d['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        keep = ['year'] + month_cols
        d = d[keep]
        long = d.melt(id_vars=['year'], value_vars=month_cols, var_name='monthName', value_name='precip')
        long['month'] = long['monthName'].map(month_num).astype('Int64')
        long['station'] = station
        # 'M' denotes missing in some files
        long['precip'] = long['precip'].replace({'M': pd.NA, '': pd.NA, 'nan': pd.NA})
        long['precip'] = pd.to_numeric(long['precip'], errors='coerce')
        return long[['station','year','month','precip']]

    allp = pd.concat([
        to_long(precipAmherst, 'amherst'),
        to_long(precipAshburnham, 'ashburnham'),
        to_long(precipBoston, 'boston'),
        to_long(precipChatham, 'chatham')
    ], ignore_index=True)

    allp = allp[(allp['year']>=2020) & (allp['year']<=2023)].copy()

    # average precip across stations per (year, month)
    m = allp.groupby(['year','month'], as_index=False)['precip'].mean()

    # full grid and impute missing with median of that month across non-missing years in 2020-2023
    years = list(range(2020, 2024))
    months = list(range(1, 13))
    grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([years, months], names=['year', 'month']).to_frame(index=False)
    m = grid.merge(m, on=['year','month'], how='left')

    monthMedian = m.groupby('month', as_index=False)['precip'].median(numeric_only=True).rename(columns={'precip': 'monthMedian'})
    m = m.merge(monthMedian, on='month', how='left')
    m['precipImputed'] = m['precip'].fillna(m['monthMedian'])

    return m[['year','month','precipImputed']].sort_values(['year','month']).reset_index(drop=True)
input.summary: Transform monthly_precipitations_{amherst,ashburnham,boston,chatham}.csv to long format: keep Year and Jan-Dec; drop non-year summary rows (e.g., Max/Min) by requiring 4-digit Year; convert 'M'/blank to NA and precip to numeric; filter years 2020-2023; compute mean precipitation across stations per [year, month]; create complete 2020-2023 x months grid; impute missing precip with median precipitation of same month across non-missing years within 2020-2023; output [year, month, precipImputed] sorted.

def process(freshExceedanceMonthly, rainMonthly) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = freshExceedanceMonthly.merge(rainMonthly, on=['year','month'], how='inner')
    df = df.sort_values(['year','month']).reset_index(drop=True)

    # aggregate to annual values (mean monthly exceedance rate; total/mean rainfall trend shouldn't matter for direction)
    annual = df.groupby('year', as_index=False).agg(
        exceedanceRate=('exceedanceRateImputed', 'mean'),
        rainfall=('precipImputed', 'sum')
    ).sort_values('year')

    # compute year-over-year direction (+1, -1, 0)
    annual['exDelta'] = annual['exceedanceRate'].diff()
    annual['rainDelta'] = annual['rainfall'].diff()

    def sign(x):
        if pd.isna(x):
            return pd.NA
        if x > 0:
            return 1
        if x < 0:
            return -1
        return 0

    annual['exSign'] = annual['exDelta'].map(sign)
    annual['rainSign'] = annual['rainDelta'].map(sign)

    # compare signs for 2021-2023 vs previous year
    comp = annual.dropna(subset=['exSign','rainSign']).copy()
    sameTrend = bool((comp['exSign'] == comp['rainSign']).all())

    return pd.DataFrame([{'sameTrend': sameTrend}])
input.summary: Join imputed monthly Fresh-beach exceedance rates with imputed monthly rainfall on [year, month] (2020-2023). Aggregate to annual series: mean monthly exceedanceRateImputed per year and total precipImputed (sum over months) per year. Compute year-over-year deltas and their signs (+/-/0) for 2021-2023 and test whether exceedance-rate sign equals rainfall sign in each transition; return single boolean column sameTrend.

      def process(water2020, water2021, water2022, water2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
          import pandas as pd
      
          def prep(df):
              out = df.copy()
              out = out[out['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'fresh']
              v = out['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
              out['violationFlag'] = v.isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', '1'])
              out['sampleDate'] = pd.to_datetime(out['Sample Date'], errors='coerce')
              out['year'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
              out['month'] = out['sampleDate'].dt.month.astype('Int64')
              out = out.dropna(subset=['year', 'month'])
              return out
      
          allw = pd.concat([prep(water2020), prep(water2021), prep(water2022), prep(water2023)], ignore_index=True)
      
          g = allw.groupby(['year', 'month'], as_index=False).agg(
              totalSamples=('violationFlag', 'size'),
              exceedSamples=('violationFlag', 'sum')
          )
          g['exceedanceRate'] = g['exceedSamples'] / g['totalSamples']
      
          # full month grid 2020-2023
          years = list(range(2020, 2024))
          months = list(range(1, 13))
          grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([years, months], names=['year', 'month']).to_frame(index=False)

      def process(freshExceedanceMonthly, rainMonthly) -> pd.DataFrame:
          import pandas as pd
      
          df = freshExceedanceMonthly.merge(rainMonthly, on=['year','month'], how='inner')
          df = df.sort_values(['year','month']).reset_index(drop=True)
      
          # aggregate to annual values (mean monthly exceedance rate; total/mean rainfall trend shouldn't matter for direction)
          annual = df.groupby('year', as_index=False).agg(
              exceedanceRate=('exceedanceRateImputed', 'mean'),
              rainfall=('precipImputed', 'sum')
          ).sort_values('year')
      
          # compute year-over-year direction (+1, -1, 0)
          annual['exDelta'] = annual['exceedanceRate'].diff()
          annual['rainDelta'] = annual['rainfall'].diff()
      
          def sign(x):
              if pd.isna(x):
                  return pd.NA
              if x > 0:
                  return 1
              if x < 0:
                  return -1
              return 0
      
          annual['exSign'] = annual['exDelta'].map(sign)
          annual['rainSign'] = annual['rainDelta'].map(sign)
      
          # compare signs for 2021-2023 vs previous year
          comp = annual.dropna(subset=['exSign','rainSign']).copy()
          sameTrend = bool((comp['exSign'] == comp['rainSign']).all())
      
          return pd.DataFrame([{'sameTrend': sameTrend}])
